zuslothdb

zuslothdb is to SlothDB what duckdb is to DuckDB. The engine’s C++ source is bundled into the package and compiled when you install it. On top of it sits a DBI driver, so SQL over local CSV, Parquet, JSON and Arrow IPC files works with no system library, no server and no download. SlothDB calls itself experimental, and so is this package: it is not a duckdb replacement.

The package is in development. Nothing of the engine is built yet; the roadmap takes it to its first release.

Installation

You can install the development version of zuslothdb from GitHub with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zuslothdb")
